checkpoints.description: [1/2] Scaffold a React surface with token theme, inventory proof and UI contract

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a test project to exercise AIKit's UI changes.
impact_assessment.benefits: A runnable React+Vite surface with a committed bounded UI contract and mechanical proofs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new .aikit/ui.json surface app; dependency: react, react-dom, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react; concurrency: none; state: .aikit/ui.json committed as baseline
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep edits inside src/**, prove with npm run build, npm test and npm run ui:snapshot, then run aikit check.
